name: ocr-to-clipboard
title: OCR to Clipboard
description: Select an area of the screen, recognize its text on-device with Apple Vision, and copy it to the clipboard.
author: lucienklein

commands.name: capture-text
commands.title: Capture Text
commands.subtitle: OCR
commands.description: Drag-select a screen area, OCR it and copy the text to the clipboard.

commands.name: clipboard-image-text
commands.title: Copy Text from Clipboard Image
commands.subtitle: OCR
commands.description: OCR the image currently on the clipboard and replace it with the recognized text.

commands.name: finder-files-text
commands.title: Copy Text from Selected Files
commands.subtitle: OCR
commands.description: OCR the images or PDFs selected in Finder and copy the text.

preferences.name: primaryLanguage
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Main language of the text you capture. Auto uses the languages your Mac is set up with.

preferences.name: languages
preferences.title: Additional Languages
preferences.description: Advanced: extra BCP-47 codes, comma-separated (e.g. de-DE, it-IT), tried after the main language.

preferences.name: autoDetectLanguage
preferences.title: Language Detection
preferences.label: Automatically detect the language
preferences.description: Let Vision detect the language of the text. Disable if results are wrong for your language and set Languages instead.

preferences.name: lineMode
preferences.title: Line Breaks
preferences.description: Keep one line per recognized line, or merge lines into paragraphs (a blank line is kept between paragraphs).

preferences.name: columnSeparator
preferences.title: Columns
preferences.description: What to put between text blocks that sit far apart on the same row, like table cells. Tab pastes into separate spreadsheet cells.

preferences.name: pasteAfterCopy
preferences.title: After Copy
preferences.label: Also paste into the frontmost app
preferences.description: Paste the recognized text into the active application right after copying it.

preferences.name: confirmation
preferences.title: Confirmation
preferences.description: How to confirm that the text was copied. Failures always show a message.

preferences.name: sound
preferences.title: Sound
preferences.description: Sound played when the text is copied. Chime and Blip ship with the extension; the others are macOS's own UI sounds.

preferences.name: showPreview
preferences.title: HUD Message
preferences.label: Show a preview of the text in the HUD
preferences.description: When the HUD message is enabled, show the first line of the recognized text instead of only the line count.
